Ametria Dock has fashioned an active career in the music world as a vocal soloist, coach and arranger. She frequently performs with Janelle Monae and India.Arie, and runs her own company, Fruition Organized Music.
Ametria was interviewed in Clinton, New York on April 4, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive. I’m very pleased to have Ametria Dock here with me today.
Thank you for having me here. I’m glad to be here.
Vocalist and coach and wearer of many hats as you said yesterday.
Absolutely. A lot of hats, but all very enjoyable hats. I’m a vocal coach — well I’ll start by saying I’m a wife, I’m a mother, I’m a vocal coach, I’m a singer, songwriter, vocal producer, so —
